mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, password, email, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT user_id as userId, username, password, email, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM users WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT user_id as userId, username, password, email, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
